dict.string: Alo Driver uses your camera to capture and upload vehicle documents, driver's license, and profile photos required for driver verification. For example, you can photograph your vehicle registration to complete your profile setup.
Your location is used in the background to provide live driver tracking, update trip status, improve pickup accuracy, and help riders see your real-time location during active trips.

Alo Driver requires your location in the background to keep you navigating to pickup points and destinations without interruption. For example, turn-by-turn directions continue to update while you use other apps during an active ride.
Your location is used to receive nearby ride requests, navigate to pickup and drop locations, and track trip progress while using the app.

Alo Driver accesses your photo library so you can upload your profile photo, driver's license, and vehicle documents required for account verification. For example, you can select an existing photo of your vehicle registration from your library to submit during signup.

Alo Driver sends you notifications for new ride requests, ride status updates, and passenger messages. For example, you will receive an alert when a nearby passenger requests a ride so you can accept it promptly.
